column1: # Golden-matrix cases for check-citations.{sh,ps1} (issue #432).
# name<TAB>golden<TAB>want_exit
# Each name is a fixture REPO ROOT under tests/fixtures/check-citations/<name>/;
# each golden is a file under tests/fixtures/check-citations/_expected/.
# A named-but-missing golden is FATAL, never a silent "expect empty".
# Both runners drive THIS table and assert against THESE goldens, so the bash
# and pwsh legs are held byte-identical.
# FOUR MORE CASES ARE NOT IN THIS TABLE because they cannot be git-tracked, and
# each runner BUILDS them instead — byte for byte, identically, asserting the
# same committed goldens:
#   missing-root   a REPO_ROOT that is not a directory (fail-loud on stderr)
#   default-root   no argument at all, run from inside a fixture root
#   gen-bytes      CRLF, a UTF-8 BOM, a file with no final newline, a raw
#                  non-UTF-8 byte inside an anchor, a UTF-16 target, and a
#                  dot-dot path reaching outside the checkout.
#                  `.gitattributes` pins tests/fixtures/** to `text eol=lf`, so
#                  a committed CRLF file is renormalized on checkout and a
#                  committed UTF-16 file is corrupted by that same conversion.
#                  Goldens: gen-bytes.txt
#   gen-unix       a symlink, a FIFO, and a chmod-000 directory — none of them
#                  git-storable. Reports SKIPPED on Windows, where a FIFO and an
#                  unprivileged symlink do not exist; CI runs both legs on
#                  Linux. Goldens: gen-unix.txt
